dissolve.fragment: precision mediump float;uniform sampler2D uMain;uniform sampler2D uNoise;uniform float uTime;uniform float uSmooth;uniform vec2 uNoiseScale;uniform vec2 uNoiseSpeed;uniform vec2 uRadialSpeed;varying vec2 vUv;void main(){vec4 base=texture2D(uMain,vUv);vec2 nuv=vUv*uNoiseScale+uNoiseSpeed*uTime;float n=texture2D(uNoise,nuv).r;vec2 c=vUv-0.5;float r=length(c)*(1.0+uRadialSpeed.x*uTime);float th=clamp(uTime*0.35,0.0,1.0);float m=smoothstep(n-uSmooth,n+uSmooth,th+r*0.1);gl_FragColor=vec4(base.rgb*m*base.a*m,base.a*m);}

onechannel.fragment: precision mediump float;uniform sampler2D uMain;uniform float uTime;uniform vec3 uMainChannel;varying vec2 vUv;void main(){vec4 base=texture2D(uMain,vUv);float m=dot(base.rgb,uMainChannel);gl_FragColor=vec4(base.rgb*m,base.a*m);}
